scope: Semantic feature families only; final tensor ordering/scaling is T05. Widths for legacy blocks are pinned, not a 706-column proposal.

features.semantics: scalar enum code; OTHER is observed unknown method, never missing
Requires original privacy projection; sanitized path alone cannot reconstruct URI/query syntax
Requires declared input profile and selected headers; never merge independently hashed source vectors
Only existing qualified body-syntax side-channel; neither standard NGINX nor Student audit currently emits this
Compare same observation point; app/wire status conflict is not a benign/attack label
Producer timing semantics differ; select profile, do not average
NGINX request_length includes headers; sensor body length is a different measurement
body_bytes_sent differs from TCP bytes; no silent conversion
ADMIN/STAFF/STUDENT/ANONYMOUS explicit enum; missing distinct from anonymous
Observed authorization/session context, not inferred from HTTP200
duration/bytes/packets of prior COMPLETED flow; not current request totals
Deduplicate canonical request identity across sources before counting
Only accepted prior request events at decision cutoff
Distinct request denials, not independent attack GT; share evidence group with policy
Observed duration of history, never assume warm on startup

producer_evidence.additional_profile: scripts/ai-shadow-worker.py reads bounded raw URI/selected headers in memory; host installer omits query

limits: flow context is not per-request evidence
TLS must be visible at a declared observation point
restart namespace and received_at need explicit future adapter binding
outcome is HTTP success/failure, not attack intent

legacy_constraints.numeric76: Feature order and transform pinned by v2 bundle; values cannot be reconstructed from an already-redacted canonical URI
legacy_constraints.rich512: Shared L2 hash across content; cross-source hashed sums/averages invalid; choose one attested profile
legacy_constraints.body46: 11state+4media+31syntax dimensions; allowlist specific to research workflows; not universal production coverage
legacy_constraints.glu207: Do not concatenate207+588 blindly; exclude rule context; choose causal nonduplicate components; missing native tx_id is not restored by feature copy

selection: One feature_id per view: choose one attested input profile. Alternative producer measurements remain evidence, not averaged or concatenated. Missing values are null.
history: PRIOR_CONTEXT events do not contribute to native mask/correlation. Windowed aggregates require an external content-addressed history manifest with contributor identities, receipt/availability bounds, dedup policy, partition boundary and count; no raw payload. Validator checks references, not that a referenced manifest or attestation is truthful.
